# Contributing

## Getting Started

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MCPBlender/blender-mcp
cd blender-mcp
uv sync
```

## Development Workflow

1. Fork the repo
2. Branch: `git checkout -b feat/my-feature`
3. Change, test in Blender + Claude
4. Commit: `feat: add my feature`
5. Open a PR

## Code Style

- PEP 8, type hints where practical
- Small, focused functions
- No new dependencies without discussion

## Testing

Test your changes:
- All existing tools still work
- Your new tool/fix works end-to-end with Blender connected
- Test on at least one platform

## Discord

Join [Discord](https://discord.gg/SNqPn4TcKQ) to discuss ideas before building large features.
